documents.text: US full-time employees receive 15 paid vacation days per calendar year.
Vacation requests must be submitted at least 3 business days in advance and require manager approval.
US full-time employees may claim up to USD 35 per meal during approved business travel. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
Itemized receipts must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the expense date.
US full-time employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval.
Remote employees must be available from 10 AM to 3 PM Eastern Time on working days.
